case_title: Smt. Hansaguri Prafulchandra Ladhani ... vs The Oriental Insurance Company Ltd. And ...

parties.respondent: The Oriental Insurance Company Ltd. And ...

decision_evidence: 171. Award of interest where any claim is allowed.- Where any Claims Tribunal allows a claim for compensation made under this Act, such Tribunal may direct that in addition to the amount of compensation simple interest shall also be paid at such rate and from such date not earlier than the date of making the claim as it may specify in this behalf.
